evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: C0001 shows a coherent multi-modal molecular pattern. RNA has the largest number of significant Hallmark pathways (18/50) with moderate-to-large SMDs (0.6-0.78) and low BH-q, dominated by up-regulation of immune/inflammatory pathways (allograft rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3, interferon responses) and MYC/E2F targets. WXS shows one FDR-significant gene (BAP1, OR=16.4) with a wide confidence interval reflecting the low rest mutation count (1/53); PBRM1 is elevated but does not reach q<=0.05. CNV shows a consistent pattern of 9p/9q loss (CDKN2A, JAK2, chr9p, chr9q) with moderate Cliff's deltas (~0.43-0.47) and significant q-values, plus chr1q gain (delta 0.383, q=0.014). The RNA, WXS, and CNV signals are directionally coherent in that they all distinguish C0001 from the rest, though they highlight different biological axes (immune/inflammatory RNA, BAP1/PBRM1 mutation, 9p/9q deletion).
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: The combination of BAP1 mutation enrichment, PBRM1 elevation, and 9p/9q loss (including CDKN2A and JAK2 loci) is a recognizable molecular configuration in renal cell carcinoma biology. The RNA up-regulation of immune and inflammatory Hallmark pathways (allograft rejection, IL6-JAK-STAT3, interferon alpha/gamma) suggests an immune/inflammatory transcriptional program. These are descriptive molecular associations; no prognostic or treatment-response inference is made.
limitations: BAP1 OR confidence interval is very wide (2.05-131.77) due to sparse rest mutations.
PBRM1 does not reach FDR significance.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: C0002 shows a strong RNA signal (23/50 significant Hallmark pathways) and a strong CNV signal (19/49 significant continuous features, 5 significant gain/loss features), but no FDR-significant WXS mutation enrichment. The RNA pattern is distinct from C0001: allograft rejection and MYC targets are down-regulated, while pancreas beta cells, heme metabolism, and TGF-beta signaling are up-regulated. The CNV pattern is dominated by lower copy number at chr12p, chr16p, chr12q, chr16q, and fga, and by depletion of 9p/9q loss (CDKN2A, JAK2) and chr14q loss relative to the rest. The RNA and CNV signals are internally coherent (both distinguish C0002 from rest) but highlight different axes; WXS provides only a non-significant PBRM1 trend.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: The CNV profile of C0002 (lower 12p/12q/16p/16q, absence of 9p/9q loss) and the RNA profile (down allograft rejection and MYC targets, up TGF-beta and heme metabolism) describe a molecular configuration distinct from C0001. The absence of FDR-significant mutation enrichment suggests C0002 is not primarily defined by a single driver mutation. These are descriptive associations; no prognostic or mechanistic claims are made.

evidence_reports.statistical_interpretation: C0003 is characterized by a striking WXS signal: complete absence of PBRM1 mutation (0/30 vs 39/73, OR=0.014, q=4.59e-07), the strongest single FDR-significant finding across all sets. BAP1 is also absent (0/30 vs 13/73) but does not reach FDR significance (q=0.107). VHL mutation is lower (0.367 vs 0.616, q=0.160). In contrast, RNA shows no FDR-significant pathway enrichment (0/50, min q=0.335), and CNV shows no FDR-significant continuous or gain/loss differences (min q=0.056 and 0.060 respectively), though the top CNV continuous features (VHL, SETD2, PBRM1, chr3p, BAP1) trend higher_in_set. The WXS signal is strong and internally coherent (loss of PBRM1/BAP1/VHL mutations), but it is not corroborated by FDR-significant RNA or CNV findings.
evidence_reports.medical_interpretation: The absence of PBRM1 and BAP1 mutations in C0003, together with lower VHL mutation frequency, describes a molecular configuration that is distinct from the PBRM1/BAP1-mutant pattern seen in C0001. The CNV trend toward higher VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/chr3p/BAP1 copy number is consistent with a less rearranged 3p region, but this does not reach FDR significance. These are descriptive associations; no prognostic or mechanistic claims are made.
limitations: RNA and CNV show no FDR-significant findings, so biological support for C0003 rests primarily on the WXS PBRM1 absence.
The CNV continuous and gain/loss trends are nominal only (q~0.056-0.060).
